note: Policy to apply when the hosted PostgreSQL and S3-compatible store exist. Nothing is provisioned or observed yet.

roles: lexaegis_indexer (separate database or role; no access to operational tables)
database.tls: verify certificates through the maintained pg client configuration; never disable verification
database.migrations: once, from the controlled release job (pnpm release migrate), under pg_advisory_lock(4172001), additive only; no down migrations, resets or recreation

backups.note: Enable the provider's backup facility and record a bounded retention before launch. Not enabled.

versioningOrRetention.note: Enable provider versioning with a bounded retention; not enabled.

objectStore.capabilityProbe: the existing conditional-create probe (apps/web/src/server/vault/object-store.ts): identical retry succeeds, conflicting overwrite fails, read-back digest/length matches. An ETag is not the application's SHA-256. Unknown capability keeps the vault unavailable.

recovery: Account and vault recovery needs the original credential on the original rpId. Restoring ciphertext cannot recreate a deleted credential. No key escrow.
